EDA-15Missing Failover For Ethereum RPC Call Failures In Certificate Verification
Assetapi/clients/v2/verification/cert_verifier.go
StatusResolved: See Resolution
RatingInformational
<|det|>title [68, 255, 178, 273]<|/det|>Description <|det|>text [66, 294, 932, 354]<|/det|>Ethereum RPC call failures in certificate verification are treated as CertVerifierInternalError without triggering a failover mechanisms. These errors will propagate as a 500 response. For the Optimism case, this would result in the node waiting briefly, and then retries the /GET request to fetch a certificate. As a result, the issue presents as an informational severity item that causes short-lived delays rather than a sustained outage. <|det|>text [67, 365, 779, 382]<|/det|>The code at lines \( [94-100] \) performs an Ethereum contract call without proper error classification. <|det|>text [73, 390, 507, 404]<|/det|>api/clients/v2/verification/cert_verifier.go: CheckDACert() <|det|>text [73, 409, 567, 488]<|/det|>returnData, err := cv.ErrClient.CallContract(ctx, ethereum.CallMsg[To: SecretVerifierAddr, Data: callMsgBytes, n], nil) if err != nil { return $CertVerifierInternalErrorMsg: "checkDACert eth call", Err: err} } <|det|>title [68, 524, 238, 540]<|/det|>Recommendations <|det|>text [67, 563, 734, 580]<|/det|>Consider classifying RPC call failures as failover-eligible errors to enable retry mechanisms. <|det|>title [68, 613, 169, 629]<|/det|>Resolution <|det|>text [66, 651, 931, 681]<|/det|>The issue has been resolved by documenting the behaviour and instructing users to configure and external failover mechanism in PR #2211. <|det|>footer [75, 925, 206, 945]<|/det|>sigm chronos <|det|>page_number [810, 931, 881, 946]<|/det|>Page | 27
